edits.description: Add an executable child-scope operation that clears only whole-entry recursion eligibility.
edits.after:
-- Only the whole expression reached after opening a declaration's actual entry
-- may establish its recursion equation. Child computations retain established
-- IH replacements but cannot manufacture another equation for that declaration.
def psErasureNestedRuntimeScope (scope : PsErasureScope) : PsErasureScope :=
  PsErasureScope.mk scope.localContext scope.runtimeLocals scope.typeLocals
    scope.erasedLocals scope.declarationNames scope.runtimeConstructors
    scope.runtimeRecursors scope.runtimeStructures scope.runtimeStructureConstructors
    scope.runtimeExpressions Option.none

def psEraseRuntimeExprWithFuelWorker

edits.description: Every recursive expression descent retains installed IH expressions but clears eligibility to create a new current-definition recurrence.
edits.before:
let smaller : PsErasureScope -> PsExpr -> Except PsErasureError PsVerifiedIrExpr :=
        psEraseRuntimeExprWithFuelWorker environment remaining;

purpose: Only the actual whole expression after aligned declaration opening may use currentDefinition to construct a recursive-hypothesis replacement. Every recursive child computation retains the already constructed replacements but loses permission to construct a new whole-definition recurrence.

sourceCaseArgument.entry: psEraseOpenDefinition calls the expression eraser after consuming the actual aligned raw type/value prefix. This initial expression receives currentDefinition and its actual ordered type/runtime parameters.
sourceCaseArgument.descent: The sole self-recursive worker binding now builds a typed callback which clears currentDefinition in the supplied child scope, leaving localContext, runtimeLocals, typeLocals, erasedLocals, declarationNames including entries, constructor/recursor/structure indexes, and runtimeExpressions unchanged.
sourceCaseArgument.rootMinor: psEraseRuntimeRecursorApplication and psOpenMatchMinorHypotheses inspect the original root scope before their eraseAt callback. They can install the valid outer IH expressions. When eraseAt lowers the minor body, the callback clears eligibility but retains those expressions.
sourceCaseArgument.nestedForms: Callee/operand, primitive, special completion/suffix, constructor field, projection target, lambda body, let initializer/body and nested minor paths all enter through that same recursive callback. No nested recursor can infer a new whole-definition equation merely from an entry-parameter spelling.
sourceCaseArgument.scope: This erasure correction is paired with the source producer's constructor-refinement and one-shot root-IH correction. It is not a standalone proof that arbitrary caller-supplied raw scopes or arbitrary Core recursors denote the current definition.
sourceCaseArgument.sourceOwnedRootOrigin: Term's ordinary global reference constructs constE name [] and immediately calls psElabResolvedTerm. Infer rejects incorrect universe arity. Nat.rec, List.rec, Option.rec, Except.rec, Prod.rec and every authored regular recursor each have one declared universe parameter; generated match supplies its inferred result level. Thus direct authored raw recursor heads are refused before their arguments are elaborated. This is a source-owned reachability premise, not a stronger raw-Core API contract.
